name: mentor
description: Mentor mode: Claude points the way instead of writing your code. Blocks file edits, gates requests for ready-made code until you have tried, escalates hints step by step and reviews your week.

language.title: Language of hook messages
language.description: pl or en. Empty = from the system locale. Claude itself answers in the language you write in.

default_mode.title: Default kind of work
default_mode.description: practice (you solve it, hints on request), guided (Claude leads in small steps), debug (hypothesis and experiments; the gate opens with /mentor:try), read (understanding code, no gate) or explain (Claude writes code and checks you understand it). A task title can also set it (a bug → debug). Change per repo with /mentor:mode.

log_text.title: Keep your text in the events log
log_text.description: Off: the log keeps only the length of prompts, commands and hypotheses, never their text, so no code or confidential prompt ends up there. On: the first 120–200 characters are kept.

activation.title: Where mentor mode applies
activation.description: always = in every repo where the plugin is enabled. marker = only in repos with a .mentor file at the root or turned on with /mentor:enable (safe for a global install).

off_minutes.title: Pause length (minutes)
off_minutes.description: How long /mentor:off lifts the blocks before mentor mode comes back on its own.

attempt_min_lines.title: Lines that count as an attempt
attempt_min_lines.description: How many changed lines of code (since the task or the session started) open the try-first gate.

attempt_ignore.title: Extra files that do not count as an attempt
attempt_ignore.description: Comma-separated globs on top of the built-in list (lock files, dist/, build/, coverage/, *.log…), e.g. 'src/generated/, *.snap'.

focus_topics.title: Focus topics
focus_topics.description: Comma-separated areas you want to grow in, e.g. 'Angular signals, RxJS, networking'. Used by /mentor:whats-new and the weekly quiz.

bash_guard.title: Guard file-writing shell commands
bash_guard.description: Best effort: shell commands that look like they write files (redirects, sed -i, Set-Content, git checkout…) trigger a permission prompt while mentor mode is on.

bash_guard_deny.title: Deny instead of asking
bash_guard_deny.description: The shell guard denies those commands instead of asking. Use it when your permission mode accepts prompts automatically.

chat_code_lines.title: Code lines in an answer that get logged
chat_code_lines.description: An answer with at least this many lines in code blocks while mentor mode is active is logged for the weekly review. It is never blocked.

keep_days.title: Keep the events log (days)
keep_days.description: Older events are removed from events.jsonl once a day. The learning journal is never pruned.

gate_regex.title: Custom gate pattern (regex)
gate_regex.description: Case-insensitive regex for prompts that ask for ready-made code. Empty = built-in Polish + English pattern.
